question.text: How must the face value of shares be disclosed under SEBI ICDR for a public issue?

answer.text: Disclosed along with the price band or issue price in the draft offer document, offer document, advertisements and application forms in identical font size
Only in the financial statements section of the offer document
Only in the risk factors section of the offer document
Only in the terms of the issue section of the offer document

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI ICDR requires the face value of equity shares to be disclosed wherever the price band or issue price is mentioned — in the draft offer document, the offer document, advertisements and application forms — and the face value must be shown in font size identical to that of the price band or issue price. The Trap: The "front page in a prominent manner" wording feels intuitive, but the workbook frames the rule around co-disclosure with the price band/issue price in identical font size across the listed documents, not a single front-page location. Note: The identical-font-size requirement is the operative safeguard — it prevents the face value from being visually de-emphasised relative to the issue price wherever the two appear together.
